capabilities: Export notes to PDF with saved presets
Print notes directly to a printer
Customize page layout with paper size, margins, logos, borders, headers and footers
Hide marked content from printouts with the print-hide class
extras: Free and local-only with no accounts, telemetry or network requests. Mobile PDFs contain page images with non-selectable text; desktop output keeps selectable text. README links to external quick guide, developer docs and contribution pages.
problem: Obsidian's built-in export offers little control over printed page layout, so users cannot easily produce customized PDFs with letterheads, margins, headers and footers.

relations.evidence: keep supported styling from your note, CSS snippets and plugins such as Fast Text Color

summary: Print and PDF export tool that renders notes into polished, customized PDFs and printed pages using reusable presets.
